履修条件
This course is intended for graduate students who wish to become university faculty or work as TFs in the future. There are no special pre-requirements, but there are many assignments, so students should be able to secure their own time.
In addition, to implement short-time mock lesson called micro-teaching, the maximum number of applicants is set to 14. So when there are more applicants than that number, considering the situation of the applicants, those who can attend the class will be selected. You will be on the priority list the next time if you are not selected.
授業概要
大学教員は、研究者としてだけでなく、教育者としての重要な役割を担っています。一方で、研究者としての技術は研究室で指導教員から学べますが、大学に就職した後で、どのように教育を実践するかに関しては学習できる機会が少ないのが現状です。そこで、本授業では大学の授業をデザインするための具体的な方法について学びます。
大学の授業をデザインする際には、「授業設計」「授業実践」「授業評価」の大きく3つの段階があります。本授業では、「授業設計」として目標の設定とシラバスの作成方法、「授業実践」として教室での具体的な教え方、「授業評価」として学生の学習成果を評価する方法について、それぞれの受講生が将来的に担当する授業を想定して実践的に学びます。
そのため、将来的に大学教員を目指す受講生には、是非ともこれらの方法論を身につけてもらいたいと思います。
University faculty members play important roles not only as researchers but also as educators. On the other hand, unlike research skills, graduate students have few opportunities to learn instructional skills required for a job at a university. Hence, in this course, the basic theory and method for designing university courses will be introduced.
When designing university courses, it is important to consider the following three stages: "course design," "course delivery," "course assessment." In this course, participants will acquire the knowledge and skills necessary to develop course syllabus; to deliver materials in the class; to assess student learning outcomes.
Therefore, I would like students who aim to be future university faculty members to learn this practical knowledge and skills.

授業形態
（内容）
Lecture or Seminar:
Lectures will be given on the situation surrounding higher education, the basic structure of courses, the characteristics of effective courses, and a course design method called backward design. The lecturer will also explain learning objectives, assessments, syllabuses, science of learning, various teaching methods, and session design.
Group or pair work:
Students will receive feedback on their artifacts.
Presentation:
Students perform micro teaching: individual-level (15 min), group-level (30 min). The other students in the class are your students.
Discussion:
You can receive comments from other students and instructors on your micro-teaching to improve it.
使用する教材等
Blackboard writing, text (paper medium), slide material (electronic medium), video / audio material
全体の教育目標
To acquire practical knowledge and skills necessary for designing high-quality courses in higher education.
個別の教育目標
Through this course, students are expected to be able to:

2. Conduct understandable session
3. Implement modernized session

授業の進め方
【In-class learning】
In the course, I will first explain the situation in Japan and overseas surrounding university education. After that, we will learn course design.
In the classroom, we will exchange opinions with other students about the learning objectives, assessments, syllabus, and performance in micro-teaching. Although this course includes many presentations and discussions, it is also one of the active learning exercises required for future university education. I will firmly support you so that you can efficiently participate in the classroom activities, so please do not be afraid to join.
【On-demand class】
For students’ convenience and learning effectiveness, some sessions are prepared in on-demand format. Students need to finish watching these videos before coming to next class.
【Out-of-class learning】
Making a course design is a very time-consuming task. So it cannot be all done within one lesson time. It may be necessary to relearn the knowledge of the specialized field. Therefore, out-of-class learning is required. I hope this “relearning” is intellectually interesting work.
テキスト
I use PowerPoint slides for an explanation. All the slides will be given as a handout. After class, we will also hand it over as data.
